arxiv-2209-03862.title: Production of T c ​ c + T^{+}_{cc} in heavy ion collisions
arxiv-2209-03862.creator: L. M. Abreu, F. S. Navarra, M. Nielsen, H. P. L. Vieira
arxiv-2209-03862.description: Abstract We study the production of heavy multiquark states in the heavy ion collisions performed at the LHC. We assume that they are produced at the end of the quark-gluon plasma phase and then interact with light hadrons during the hadron gas phase. We use the coalescence model to compute the initial multiplicities and effective Lagrangians to describe the interactions.

arxiv-2308-01679.description: Abstract . The equivariant movability of topological spaces with an action of a given topological group G G is considered. arxiv-2511-11559.creator: Alex Kasman, Robert Milson
arxiv-2511-11559.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alex Kasman, Robert Milson. Sequences are often conveniently encoded in the form of a generating function depending on a formal variable. The first constructively produces “recursion relations” for the sequence from differential operators in the formal variable having the generating function as an eigenfunction.
